answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the ripple of a task receipt, and the zenith is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. By the nectar of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, weighted by independent path length, idle agents bleed standing.
